speaker: arthur_meeks
text: Edith let the hem down two fingers at Easter, sir, and my shins are out in the wind again. Make the next lady tall and angry about it!

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear the shins. I am not writing thee a new lady before dinner. This afternoon is Egeon's, and Egeon is mine.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The hem is Edith's work. The plot is on the nail. I am not renaming a door because the yard is wider.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I will stand where the plot puts me. The wind will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are rehearsed. The doors are the doors we had. A twin who comes out of the wrong one is a miss, not a new house.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: If he misses, I will say so. I will not invent a third house to catch him.
